## What it is

Ollama downloads and runs open language models locally and serves them over an HTTP API, including an OpenAI-compatible one under `/v1` ([ollama/ollama](https://github.com/ollama/ollama)). It has no web UI of its own: LibreChat and other apps use it.

**Licence:** `MIT` (GitHub licence API; license-matrix row "Ollama"). Market class **L1**. Each model has its own licence, shown by `ollama show --license`; the owner accepts it when pulling.

**Icon:** a neutral generated icon with initials; no upstream logo is shipped.

## Market listing

- Category and sub-tags (docs/design/TAXONOMY.md §1): ai: llm-runtime. The sub-tags go into `metadata.tags` once the schema has it.
- Deployment class (TAXONOMY §2): **Market · community** until CI writes a passing scan (contract §9.4), then Market · verified if every check passes.

## How it runs here

- One `Deployment` (`Recreate`), one container, on the CPU. The image runs as root; here it runs as UID 1000 with `HOME=/var/lib/ollama` and `OLLAMA_MODELS=/var/lib/ollama/models`, so the key pair and models live on the volume (upstream mounts `/root/.ollama`). No privilege escalation, all capabilities dropped.
- Service `ollama` on 11434: other apps reach it at `http://ollama.app-ollama.svc.cluster.local:11434`. `spec.web` points at this API so the smoke test checks it; `GET /` answers "Ollama is running".
- **The API has no authentication** (upstream has no sign-in of any kind). Anything that can reach the Service can pull and delete models and use the CPU. Until OneMind isolates app namespaces (CORE-SANDBOX-5), that is every pod on the box, agent apps included.
- Volume: `ollama-data` (50 GiB).
- Memory follows the model: the 6 GiB limit fits small models (around 3B parameters at 4-bit) on an 8 GB node. Larger models need the limit and `minMemoryMb` raised.

## First run

Source: [docs.ollama.com](https://docs.ollama.com/) and docs/docker.mdx ("Run model locally").

1. Install Ollama from the Market and approve the action. It installs into `app-ollama`.
2. Pull a model:
   ```sh
   kubectl -n app-ollama exec deploy/ollama -- ollama pull llama3.2
   ```
3. Install LibreChat to chat with it, or call the API through a port-forward:
   ```sh
   kubectl -n app-ollama port-forward svc/ollama 11434:11434
   ```

## Not done yet

- No GPU: NVIDIA or AMD acceleration needs device access and a runtime class, which the contract does not allow yet (`spec.requires.gpu` stays `false`).
- No HTTPS or LAN hostname: OneMind v0 has no ingress or certificates for apps, so the web UI is reached through a port-forward until the app proxy exists.
- `readOnlyRootFilesystem` is not set: it has not been tested against this image.
- Resource figures are OneMind choices where upstream gives none; they are checked against real use when the CI smoke test (contract §9.4 check 9) runs.
- `metadata.tier` stays `community` until `sdk/tools/app-gate` in CI writes a passing `scan.json`. `spec.updates.automerge` is `none` until `renovate.json` lists the app.
